_comment: Shape reference for a guide JSON. Copy this file, replace every value with real episode content pulled from the fetched transcript, save as guides/[slug].json, then run: python scripts/render_guide.py guides/[slug].json. Fields marked optional can be dropped and the renderer fills in the defaults.
episode: Episode name as the user gave it
date: Month D, YYYY (optional, defaults to today)

project_context.summary: One short paragraph on the project itself, drawn from the transcript.
project_context.segment_choice: Which part of the episode these Shorts are cut from, and why that segment carries the hook.
project_context.publish_order: Why Short 1 publishes first and Short 2 second, and how the funnel works.

shorts.primary_goal: What this Short is supposed to do for the funnel.

scenes.vo: The VO line for this scene, ElevenLabs formatted.
scenes.caption: On-screen caption text
scenes.notes: Punch-in, arrow, highlight box, whoosh, impact sound. Always over a pre-demo walkthrough, progress state shot, or final reveal.
scenes.flag: Optional. Set only when the footage for this line may not exist, and say what to check.

shorts.full_vo: The full combined read as one paste-ready ElevenLabs block. Plain prose, no labels, no clip cues, paragraph breaks between beats are fine.
shorts.voice_direction: One or two lines of direction for the synthesis.

production_notes: Optional. Omit to use the renderer defaults.
checklist: Optional. Omit to use the renderer defaults.
